desc: The Komplete NCR is the world's first removable cartridge powered pre-charged pneumatic rifle. The Komplete NCR puts the power and accuracy of PCP air rifles into everyone's hands with no need for an electric pump. The Komplete is a truly revolutionary air rifle that is going to make a huge impact in the future of airgunning by giving consumers a smooth side-lever action, 12-shot auto-indexing rotary magazine, and tack driving accuracy and all for an amazing price.
